words.trans: v. 砰地关上、猛摔、重重撞击、猛推；n. 猛烈撞击、砰的一声。slam... into/back 把人猛摔进去
examples: He allowed his body to slam on to the steps.

words.trans: n. 重心（身体或物体重力的中心点）；引申指事情的关键核心
examples: He felt his centre of gravity shift violently.

words.trans: v./n. 咔哒、哐啷作响（硬物跌落、滚动时发出一连串清脆杂乱的响声）
examples: The stick clattering after.

words.trans: v. 使一时发懵、震晕；（撞击之后）头脑发昏
examples: The blow stunned him for several seconds.

words.trans: adj. 被震得头昏发懵、脑子空白的；（引申）震惊得说不出话的
examples: Mike was stunned, kneeling, eyes closed.

words.trans: n. 门槛（门下方的横木/横条）
examples: He gently placed Gnat on the floor next to the doorsill.

words.trans: n. 暴怒、怒火、大发雷霆。fly into a rage 勃然大怒；the rage 那股怒火
examples: His body would shield the drone from the rage when it came.

words.trans: adj. 犬的、狗一样的、像狗的；n. 犬；犬齿、虎牙——upper canine 上侧虎牙、service canine 服务犬
examples: With a canine shake of his head, Mike was on his feet.

words.trans: 固定文学短语：怒气冲冲地厉声吐出一串骂人的话；spit 在此比喻——把咒骂的话像啐唾沫一样狠狠从嘴里迸发出来
examples: Mike was on his feet, spitting curses and yanking Tom up by the hair.

words.trans: n.（旧用法）瘸子、肢体残障者；v. 使致残、严重毁坏、重创。⚠️重要：作名词 a cripple 现属冒犯、不礼貌的旧用词，现代日常英语不要用它称呼残疾人（应说 disabled person）；作动词“使瘫痪/重创(经济、系统)”仍常用
examples: 'You stupid cripple,' he growled.

words.trans: n. 蠢货、笨蛋、白痴（骂人话）
examples: 'Shut up, you moron.'

words.word: I'll break your other leg for you
words.trans: 英语口语中带威胁语气的惯用句式 I will do sth for you：字面像“替你/为你做某事”，实为挖苦恫吓——“我可要替你来干这件坏事了！我就给你点颜色瞧瞧！”for you 此处不表目的“为了你”，而是强化威胁：这份苦头就降临到你头上！
examples: 'I'll break your other leg for you, if you do that again.'

words.trans: 不算固化习语，是文学叙事里高频的动词搭配：steady（动词，稳住、平复）+ breathing（呼吸）。释义：稳住、平复自己的呼吸
examples: He took a moment to steady his breathing.

words.trans: n. 鞘、护套、外壳、套子（刀鞘、护套）。动词是 sheathe [ʃiːð]（末尾浊辅音，把…插入鞘、收进护套）
examples: He twisted the metal sheath to expose the control panel.

words.trans: n. 空隙、安全间隙、净空（两物之间留出的安全距离）
examples: He placed the machine with just enough clearance from the door.

words.trans: adv./adj. 小心翼翼地、轻手轻脚地、谨慎小心的（因怕碰坏或怕出危险而动作极轻极慢）
examples: Gingerly, he thumbed the lever.

words.trans: v. 猛扔、猛地摔出去（flung, flung）。fling itself over（机器/物体）猛一下翻倒
examples: The drone would fling itself over.

words.trans: 很地道的口语短句，小说叙事常出现：那就完事了、就此完蛋、一切就此结束（表示出了差错就彻底完蛋）
examples: The rotors would hit the step and that would be that.

words.trans: adj. 像素化的、画面有马赛克感的（分辨率太低，图像成一格一格的小方块）
examples: He could see the staircase, grey and pixelated, on the screen.

words.trans: adj. 黄蜂似的；（引申形容人的言语、脾气）尖刻易怒的——说话尖刻、性子急躁、动辄怼人。a waspish tone/reply 尖刻的语气/回话
examples: The waspish buzz echoed around the stairwell.

words.trans: adj. 震耳欲聋的、响声大得几乎要震聋耳朵的（副词 deafeningly loud 响得震耳欲聋）
examples: It seemed deafeningly loud.

words.trans: n. 金属格栅、栅栏、防护格网（如汽车水箱护罩、防护铁栅）
examples: He did a visual check through the grille.

words.trans: v./n. 短暂向下一沉、往下小幅下坠（之后还可以再回升）。程度比 drop 轻、是小幅度的下探
examples: Judging by the drone's sudden dip, it must have been a heavy key.

words.word: a matter of + 数量名词
words.trans: a matter of …：只不过是、仅仅只是（相差的数量就只有……）；用来强调数量很小、余地非常有限，就差那么一点点
examples: There were only a matter of millimetres between the blades and the door.

words.word: as + 副词 + as life itself
words.trans: 文学套路“如同生命本身一般……”：① as dearly as life itself 像珍爱生命一样珍视、爱惜地守护（出现较多）；② as tenderly as life itself 拿取时动作极尽轻柔（本书作者原创句）
examples: He took hold of the key as tenderly as life itself.

words.trans: v. 呕吐
examples: He thought he was going to vomit.

words.trans: v.（声音）回响、回荡、产生回响；引申为事件产生反响
examples: He imagined it reverberating throughout the building.

words.trans: 心里隐隐预料、有几分担心恐怕会（坏事发生）、半料想着（常用 half-expecting / half-expected to...）
examples: He listened, half-expecting to hear heavy boots running down the corridor.

words.trans: v. 妥善收起来、收纳、存放（把东西塞好、安置进某个空间内部）。stow away 收起、藏好
examples: He stowed Gnat back into his walking stick.

words.trans: n. 泛光灯、强力探照大灯；v. 用泛光灯照亮
examples: Floodlights illuminated the spiralling curl of the razor wire fence.

words.trans: v. 照亮；阐明、说明（make sense of）
examples: He stood in a small room illuminated by a dim emergency light.

words.trans: v.（swelled, swollen）膨胀、涨大；（河水）上涨；鼓起
examples: Brown soil soaking up soft rain, swelling the river that ran past his home.

words.trans: v.（pored, pored）仔细研读、凝神细看；n.（皮肤的）毛孔
examples: A pore on the skin is tiny.

words.trans: 专心仔细审阅、埋头细看（图纸、地图、文件、书）。pore over sth
examples: Pilots were poring over a chart in a route-planning meeting.

words.trans: （门、房间）open into + 房间/通道：通向某处；门之后就是这个空间
examples: A set of double doors opened into a corridor.

words.trans: v. 畏缩、蜷缩、吓得往后缩（因害怕、强光、惊吓而身体本能地蜷曲退缩）
examples: He found himself cowering against the lights.

words.trans: n. 潮虫、鼠妇（石头底下生活的小虫，一见光就蜷起来；复数 woodlice）
examples: Like a woodlouse exposed under a stone.

words.trans: 书面用法 after + 名词：和……相比、在（某环境）之后（眼前见到的）；after + [之前的环境]，用来凸显前后两种环境的强烈反差，多见于文学描写
examples: A corridor that was so bright after his cell.

words.trans: adv. 严峻地、冷着脸；心情沉重、冷静地（认清残酷现实地）
examples: He reminded himself grimly.

words.trans: 寿终正寝、老死（因年老而死亡）
examples: Everyone in the building would have died of old age.

words.trans: adj. 有吸引力的、诱人的、令人感兴趣的
examples: That wasn't so appealing either.

words.trans: n. 实验室（英式常读 /ləˈbɒrətri/）；缩写 lab
examples: The room was a laboratory, full of humming machines.

words.trans: adj. 闪烁的、忽明忽暗的
examples: Full of humming machines and flickering screens.

words.trans: n.（头发、丝线）一股、一缕、一丝（a strand of hair 一根头发）
examples: A strand of her red hair was blown out behind her.

words.trans: 拐过转角、绕过拐角（round 此处作动词/介词表绕过）
examples: He cautiously rounded the corner.

words.trans: （带 to）步行走过去、走到那个位置（强调移动到某处）
examples: She went over to the far side of the room.

words.trans: （没有 to）仔细检查、翻看、核查某物（= 复习、审阅）。与 go over to sth（走过去）区分：有无 to 决定是“检查”还是“走过去”
examples: He went over the notes before the exam.

words.trans: adj. 麻木的、失去知觉的；v. 使麻木、使愣住、心绪僵住。numbed by... 被……弄得发麻/麻木
examples: He stood under it, numbed by the sudden longing to lift off.

words.trans: n. 垂直起飞、离地升空（火箭、无人机等垂直离地的那一刻）
examples: The countdown ended and lift-off was imminent.

words.trans: n.（常用复数 giblets）（家禽的）内脏杂件（鸡、火鸡的心、肝、胗这类下水）
examples: Their electronics exposed like the giblets of a Christmas turkey.

words.trans: v.（鸟）栖息、停歇；蹲坐在……上面。be perched on 停在/栖在……上
examples: Some were perched on stands.

words.trans: adj. 向外伸开的、展开的（outstretched wings / arms 展开的翅膀/伸出的手臂）
examples: Wings outstretched like exhibits in a museum.

words.trans: 固定鸟类名词：灰林鸮（一种黄褐色羽毛的猫头鹰；tawny 指黄褐色、棕黄色）
examples: A tawny owl was standing in a corner, surveying the room.

words.trans: n. 厄运、劫数、毁灭、在劫难逃的命运；v. 注定失败、注定毁灭（be doomed to）。a feeling of doom 一种末日、不祥之感
examples: The lifeless birds gave him a feeling of doom.

words.trans: 掐灭、吹灭（蜡烛、烛火）。snuff out a candle 把蜡烛掐灭；比喻“扼杀、使（生命/希望）突然熄灭”
examples: As if some spark of life had been suddenly snuffed out.

words.trans: （线缆、道路等）引出去、延伸出去、向外牵出
examples: Cables leading off from the feathered belly.

words.trans: 威严庄重的身形、气派雄健的体态（stately 庄严气派的，form 指体态身形）
examples: Stretched across a wall was the stately form of a peregrine falcon.

words.trans: n. 游隼（世界上飞得最快的鸟，本段核心物种名）
examples: The peregrine falcon is the fastest bird in existence.

words.trans: 看得入迷、被深深吸引，仿佛被催眠一样失神地盯着（be mesmerized by... 被……迷住）
examples: He found himself mesmerized by the perfection of the thing.

words.trans: adj. 带有斑点的、散布着细碎斑纹的（delicately flecked 点缀着细碎斑纹）
examples: He reached out to touch the delicately flecked leg feathers.

words.trans: （突发事件、响声）猛地把某人从发呆/出神的状态惊醒过来，迫使他马上采取行动
examples: Voices jolted him into action.

words.trans: 现存的、世上存在的（the fastest bird in existence 现存最快的鸟）
examples: The peregrine falcon is the fastest bird in existence.

words.trans: n. 推进、推动力、推进系统（self-propelled 自带推进/自推进的）
examples: The difficulty is getting propulsion without spoiling the natural aerodynamics.

words.trans: 开始发挥作用、投入使用、生效
examples: The rocket engines come into play for the remainder of the mission.

words.trans: adj. 现行的、当时的、盛行的；（风、环境）当下的。prevailing conditions（固定搭配）当时的环境状况，多指天气、风向气流
examples: It can maintain that speed for about ten miles, depending on prevailing conditions.

words.trans: v. 躲避、规避、避开、逃过（探测、追捕、责任）。evade detection 躲过探测
examples: It can easily evade the latest drone detection systems.

words.trans: v. 笨拙地摸索、慌乱地乱摸（手脚忙乱、不好使力）。fumble at/for sth 摸索某物
examples: He fumbled at the handle.

words.trans: v.（slunk）偷偷溜走、蹑手蹑脚地潜行、悄悄地溜到（某处躲藏）
examples: He slunk behind the machine, crouching low.

words.trans: adj. 微微颤动的、抖动的、震颤的
examples: Through the tangle of quivering ducts and pipes.

words.trans: adj. 夹棉绗缝的、衍缝的（里面填充保温棉，表面有一格一格缝线）
examples: She was putting on a quilted blue suit.

words.trans: 毛衬里的兜帽（帽子里面镶皮毛；fur-lined 皮毛衬里的）
examples: A quilted blue suit with a fur-lined hood.

words.trans: 猛冲过去、趁机快速跑过去（抓住短暂时机冲刺逃跑/冲向某处）
examples: He was about to make a dash for it while she was in there.

words.trans: 描写手指迅速啪地一拨开关，灯光一下子就熄灭；动作干脆利落，转瞬之间灯就黑了（反义 flick on 啪地打开）
examples: The light flicked off, and she was gone.

words.trans: adj./v. 使麻木、使失去知觉（deadened limbs 麻木得不听使唤的四肢）
examples: He dragged his deadened limbs over the sill.

words.trans: n. 西洋李子、紫黑的李子（布拉斯李子，常制果酱/利口酒）
examples: He pulled a tub labelled Damson out.

words.trans: v. 戳、捅；用手指轻轻去杵、试探着按（用尖物或手指戳探）
examples: His finger met a surprising resistance when he prodded it.

words.trans: adj. 异国风味的、少见的、新奇的、不寻常的（exotic flavours/fruits 异域罕见的口味/水果）
examples: There was something too exotic about the selection of flavours.

words.trans: adj. 令人难受的；一阵反胃、心里发慌发怵的那种不安感
examples: He began to back away with a sickening feeling.

words.trans: 明火（英式说法）；对应美式 open flames。No Naked Flames 严禁明火（防火警示语）
examples: The sign read: Extreme Danger: No Naked Flames.

words.trans: 塑料炸药（可塑炸药）；plastic 作形容词本意“可塑的、能够捏塑改变形状的”，故 plastic explosive 可任意塑形
examples: He realized he was standing in a room full of plastic explosives.
